title: ObjC type-mapping tables
description: Single-source-of-truth tables the ObjC pipeline uses to map ObjC/C type names onto C# types, folded out of the formerly-hardcoded ObjCTypeMapper/StructsAndEnumsEmitter tables and owned by AppleFrameworkRegistry.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped in lockstep with AppleFrameworkRegistry.ExpectedObjCTypeMappingsSchemaVersion when the shape changes.

pointerTypeMappings.description: ObjC pointer/object type name -> C# type (e.g. NSString -> string, NSURL -> NSUrl).

coreFoundationRefMappings.description: CoreFoundation Ref typedefs and opaque types that appear without '*' in the clang AST -> C# type.

primitiveTypeMappings.description: C/ObjC primitive type name -> C# type (e.g. BOOL -> bool, NSInteger -> nint).

acronymConventions.description: Acronyms that Microsoft.iOS/MAUI bgen lowercases inside NS-prefixed managed names. Ordered longer-first so substring overlaps (HTTPS contains HTTP) resolve correctly.

objcValueTypes.description: Apple framework struct/value types commonly used as pointer parameters (C structs bridged to .NET value types).

systemStructs.description: Structs already defined by .NET MAUI's framework bindings — the ObjC struct emitter skips re-emitting these.

systemEnums.description: Apple SDK enums already bound by Microsoft.iOS, keyed by ObjC name and valued by the fully-qualified managed spelling ('Namespace.ManagedName', e.g. CLAuthorizationStatus -> CoreLocation.CLAuthorizationStatus). The namespace half drives the emitted 'using'; the name half is what a member's signature is bound to. Values carry the acronym convention already applied (NSJSONReadingOptions -> Foundation.NSJsonReadingOptions).
